data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue
data.body:
Hi,

I'm Andrew, founder of Local Ledger, an independent research publisher using public records only and never issuer-paid.

Gator Capital Management's most recent 13F, for the period ended June 30, 2026, shows positions in CBNA, CBK, and OPBK.

On September 10, 2026, INBK entered into a material definitive agreement, according to its Form 8-K Item 1.01 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1562463/000156246326000092/inbk-20260910.htm).

I can send the free weekly issue and offer a four-week fund pilot. Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.

Best,
Andrew
